exposure: Platelet activating factor acetylhydrolase (PAF-AH) activity in maternal plasma
cohort: The study included 73 preeclamptic women and 73 normotensive pregnant women from the Indian population.
finding: Maternal plasma PAF-AH activity levels were significantly higher in women with preeclampsia compared to normotensive controls, but PAF-AH mRNA expression was similar between the groups.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the time women were identified as having preeclampsia or being normotensive during pregnancy.
gest_age: Some focus on early-onset preeclampsia (<32 weeks) was mentioned in relation to the findings.
